lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular blobs is visible posterior to the pectoral fin, organized into roughly five vertical columns and four horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the primary horizontal blob rows to create a defined grid-like topography across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light-scattering pixels on the dorsal edge and localized shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density concentration of small, high-luminance punctate markers that are significantly smaller and more densely packed than the primary flank constellations.
